basis.decisions: The owner's approval of 2026-10-21 (amendment package Item 7: the intake act itself, section 4's lawful line included) authorised this freeze and the intake's execution in the same run. The act implemented is Item 7 section 5 exactly: the CISI 3.1 portion's numbers graded under the frozen ladder and, on pass, merged into the pinned catalogue layer, over material held under the Phase-130 gate (restricted store PROVENANCE entry 22). Freeze decisions DD-066-4 to DD-066-10 are recorded in adjudication.md section 4: halt threshold 20 percent of all graded candidates confirmed, denominator the full 2,101 census; stratum 60 with seed 20261021 fixed at freeze; no OSF registration for the intake itself; phase allocation Phase-428; the DD-038-10 gate reading adopted as DD-066-10.

design.question_owner: Spec 059's frozen outcome wording: the unblocking act it names is a more complete published object catalogue entering through Phase-130 intake; no PRED-2026 entry is scored, advanced, or retired by this act, and no F1 quantity is computed
design.act: Phase-130 catalogue extension: grade every distinct well-formed CISI 3.1 portion number under the fixed ladder (spec section 5.3); build the merged catalogue layer v2 (vols. 1-2 plus VERIFIED 3.1 objects) as a LOCAL file in the restricted store; commit only the section 4 products (the extension index, aggregates, pins)

candidates.form: census of all candidates, not a sample (DD-066-2); the referenced and unreferenced sets are graded identically and reported separately

ladder: site agreement (mandatory where referencing rows exist; the fixed Spec 037 section-to-site mapping)
extraction-confidence gate (low UNGRADED until hand-verified against the page render; medium provisional until the stratum covers its class; high passes directly)
number-level ambiguity bar (the portion's own records under one number differ on join-relevant data: section, heading type class, FC, excavation, museum, registration)
type carriage (not a gate: the published plate-heading class under the closed Spec 037 class set; blank or addenda heading is unfilled, a recorded fact)

corroboration where available (FC, excavation, museum values in the vols. 1-2 or mayig layers under the fixed normalisation: contradiction is a conflict; absence is UNGRADED; UNGRADED for every candidate on the held records, DD-066-7)

halt_rule.tripwire: any stratum attribution to true non-identity halts regardless of the conflict share
halt_rule.on_halt: the census completes and reports in full; no extension index is committed; no merged layer is pinned; the outcome is INTAKE COMPLETE - CATALOGUE EXTENSION HALTED

design.hand_check_stratum: seeded random sample stratified across the three outcome classes, attributing each sampled conflict to extraction error, programme-side record error, genuine compilation divergence, or true non-identity; size fixed at the freeze at 60 (DD-066-5: 30 VERIFIED / 15 CONFLICT / 15 UNRESOLVED, the whole class where a class is smaller; seed 20261021 fixed at the freeze and recorded in the build script before sampling; the medium-coverage supplement of spec section 5.4 is part of the design)
design.reported_aggregates: outcome counts and shares overall, by candidate set, and by portion section; conflict breakdown by reason code; per-rung graded bases; the confidence-gate accounting; type-class fill of the entered objects; the stratum's cause attribution; the halt verdict with its arithmetic; on pass, the merged layer's counts and the section 5.7 projection, labelled a projection - aggregate statistics only, never rows beyond the section 4 item-1 fact list

fences.string_match: a referenced number is a candidate, never a catalogue object
fences.verified_object: a VERIFIED catalogue object is not a verified join; no join is run under this act
fences.no_f1: no F1 quantity is computed under this act; STUDY-SPEC-024/F1 stands exactly as recorded and Spec 059's record is never patched
fences.no_osf: no OSF registration is filed for the intake itself (DD-066-8); the registration attaches to the successor F1 study spec
